answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The crystal multiplier is published, charged in nectar, and glacier lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 13 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 1243 identities would post 2417 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
